prompts.scenery: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for an original 2D top-down Vietnamese fantasy RPG. Image 1 is the approved Bright Handheld STYLE reference; image 2 is the selected village layout reference, use its prop designs and rendering language. Create ONLY an atlas of 12 independent environment props, exactly 4 columns and 3 rows, equal-size cells with generous transparent gutters, each centered on the same bottom baseline in its cell. No map, no characters. Row 1 left to right: (1) mossy grey-blue cliff bank segment, broad horizontal natural group of 4 angular rocky columns with leafy grass tops, viewed at 3/4 top down, tall exposed rock face, no water; (2) a compact taller cliff rock formation with vines and grassy cap, no water; (3) short horizontal bamboo garden fence with 3 tan posts and two green rails, front view top down; (4) side-view bamboo garden fence oriented away from camera, 3 posts, for the side of a house lot. Row 2: (5) small grey stone pagoda garden lantern, (6) tall wooden post with a hanging vermilion lantern, absolutely no writing, (7) pink lotus on two floating green lily pads, (8) cluster of white daisies and blue flowers with small green leaves. Row 3: (9) lush broad-leaf fern ground plant, (10) single grey stone entrance pillar with a round cap, (11) wooden raised herb bed with short crops, (12) rustic empty wooden bench and a little stool. Bright cheerful handheld pixel art, hard pixel clusters, crisp dark outlines, lush vivid green and moss, sunny top-down 3/4 orthographic view identical to the reference. Keep texture detail at game prop scale, no photorealism, no smooth vector gradients. Every object isolated on TRUE transparent alpha, no cast shadow plates, no labels, no border, no grid lines, no Chinese/Japanese/Korean writing, no UI. High native resolution landscape atlas.
prompts.villagers: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game animation spritesheet, 6 columns by 4 rows, exactly 24 separate small full-body sprites. Image 1 is approved Bright Handheld STYLE reference; image 2 village reference contains the target farmer and boy designs. Two ORIGINAL background villagers with the same chibi size and dark pixel outlines as the village: A is a friendly young farmer in a broad straw conical hat, simple teal shirt and tan trousers; B is a short brown-haired village boy in a brown tunic, cream scarf and dark trousers. First 3 columns are farmer A, last 3 columns are boy B. Row 1 both characters face DOWN toward camera; Row 2 both face LEFT; Row 3 both face RIGHT; Row 4 both face UP away from camera. Within each group of 3 columns show a coherent walk cycle: left foot forward, standing neutral feet, right foot forward, arms swinging in opposition. This is a strict usable sprite sheet, no extra poses, no illustrations. All 24 sprites stand in equal-sized cells, same foot baseline and visual size in each cell, generous transparent gutters so no sprites touch. Bright handheld-era pixel art, clean hard pixel clusters, no blur or smooth 3D, same palette and proportions as image 1. TRUE transparent background, no shadows, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid, no UI. High native resolution landscape 3:2 atlas.
